title: Hold a tattoo licence
what: Hold a master licence before carrying on a body art tattooing business, and employ only licensed tattooists.

sources.title: Tattoo Industry Act 2012 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a body art tattooing business (whether on the person's own behalf or on behalf of another person) at any premises unless the person is authorised to do so by a master licence.
